characters.name: Herreper
characters.description: Herreper is a young man of average height and build, with fair skin and short, brown hair. He typically wears traditional Norwegian peasant clothing, including a tunic and breeches. He’s often found in a rustic setting, dealing with magical events and surrounded by elements of an enchanted forest or a small village.

characters.name: Katten (Princess)
characters.description: Initially appearing as a regular, small house cat with sleek black fur and bright, piercing green eyes, the Katten transforms into a breathtakingly beautiful princess. As a princess, she possesses long, golden hair, fair skin, and a graceful demeanor. She dons an elegant gown adorned with intricate patterns and royal embellishments, embodying a sense of nobility and enchantment.

characters.name: Aase Gaasepige
characters.description: Aase Gaasepige is a petite, young peasant girl with a humble yet vibrant presence. She has long, blonde hair often tied back and a nimble build. Aase is often seen wearing simple and worn clothes consisting of a patched dress suitable for tending geese. She is frequently depicted in pastoral settings with geese around her, embodying a serene connection to nature and rustic simplicity.

characters.name: Kongssønen fra Engeland
characters.description: The Kongssønen fra Engeland is a noble prince characterized by his tall, stately figure and commanding yet gentle presence. His features include short, neatly-trimmed brown hair and a regal bearing. He typically dresses in opulent, richly-colored garments befitting his royal status, often with intricate embroidery. The prince appears in both indoor royal settings or riding in the countryside, symbolizing his quest for true love.
